name: Elinor Rhys
bio:
Elinor's analytical mind was honed during her physics degree at Cardiff University, where she became fascinated by the intricacies of motorsport data. After graduating, she began her career as a junior analyst for a Formula Ford team, quickly proving her aptitude for identifying subtle performance gains. Her dedication and keen eye for detail led her to positions with progressively larger teams, culminating in her current role with Iron Dames.

Elinor thrives on transforming raw data into actionable insights for the team. She is known for her rigorous methodology and ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner. Her approach is deeply rooted in evidence-based decision-making, and she constantly seeks innovative ways to refine the team's strategy using data analysis. Elinor believes that even the smallest adjustments, when informed by data, can make a significant difference on the track. Her perfectionist nature and unwavering loyalty to the team make her an invaluable asset.

What sets Elinor apart is her ability to blend her technical expertise with a deep understanding of the human element in racing. She understands that data is only as good as the people who interpret and act upon it. This understanding allows her to communicate her findings effectively to drivers and engineers alike, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone works together to optimize performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elinor has a serious but kind face framed by practical, dark hair.

quirks: Always brings a thermos of strong Welsh tea to the track.
Obsessively organizes her data spreadsheets with color-coded categories.
Has a habit of muttering statistical probabilities under her breath during races.
